title: 1:1 Prep - Sasha Patel (IC) - Emma Gonzalez
content:
Quick notes / prep for 1:1 with Sasha (30m)
Date: 2025-02-18 - 11:00am PT
Location: Zoom / slack thread follow-up

Purpose: sync on priorities, unblock Sasha, career coaching, and align on next two weeks. Keep to 30m; follow-up doc if items need >15m.

Agenda (proposed)
- 5m: personal check-in - how are you feeling, energy/workload?
- 10m: technical status - ROSA rollout (INF-342), perf regressions, infra needs
- 7m: career / growth - project leadership opportunities, mentorship
- 5m: blockers & admin - PTO, logistics, async handoffs
- 3m: action items & quick wins

Prep notes (things I want to ask / watch for)
- Energy: Sasha seemed tired in weekly - ask about context (offsite? family?) and whether load needs rebalancing.
- ROSA (rolling autoscaler) rollout: PR 1287 merged to staging but we saw a 7% p95 latency bump in staging tests yesterday. Need root-cause: batching config or kernel selection change? Sasha owns rollout testing.
- INF-342 (ROSA autoscaling policy): status says "in QA" but QA blocked on infra quota (INF-410). Confirm timeline and whether we should pause rollout to prod.
- Perf regression triage: ask for reproduction steps, perf dashboard link, and who needs to be looped in (perf eng / infra).
- Mentorship: Sasha asked about leading on-call rotation improvements; ask if they want a small project to propose changes (1 sprint) and to pair with Jamie for incident handbook updates.
- Career: gauge interest in IC3 -> senior IC track; actionable items (proposal doc, list of recent impact examples).

Notes to self / talking points
- Be explicit about available support: I can push for quota increase with infra if Sasha needs it to unblock QA.
- If Sasha wants to lead the on-call project, propose 2-week planning, define success metrics (MTTR, runbook coverage).
- Encourage running a small e2e load test with representative traces (use dataset: staging-trace-2025-02-14).
- Offer to review career draft doc next week - set a deadline for Sasha to send examples by Tue 2025-02-25.

Blockers & actions to resolve now
- Quota for QA: Confirm current limit and whether a temporary bump is possible (who: infra on-call or capacity team). Action: I will ping infra @capacity (Slack link above) during/after 1:1.
- PR 1287 perf bump: Action: Sasha to capture minimal repro script + perf dashboard link by EOD 2025-02-18. Follow-up: schedule 30m perf triage with perf-eng if no quick fix.

Action items (explicit)
1) Sasha: post repro steps + perf dashboard link in INF-342 ticket (due: 2025-02-18) - status: in progress
2) Emma (me): ping infra capacity for QA quota bump and escalate if needed (due: 2025-02-18) - status: todo
3) Sasha: draft 1-page proposal for on-call improvements (2-week project plan, owners, success metrics) (due: 2025-03-03) - status: discuss in 1:1
4) Emma & Sasha: career doc review - Sasha to send draft examples by 2025-02-25; Emma will provide written feedback by 2025-02-28
5) If regression persists: schedule perf triage meeting with perf-engineering and serving-runtime leads (Tentative: 2025-02-19) - owner: Emma to coordinate

Follow-ups I should do after the meeting
- Send summarized meeting notes and action items to Sasha (quick thread)
- Update INF-342 ticket with decisions from 1:1
- If Sasha accepts on-call project, add to roadmap and block 0.5 sprint for planning

Open questions / things to decide in meeting
- Pause prod rollout until perf is resolved? If yes, agreed rollback + communication plan.
- Does Sasha want to lead on-call improvements or pair with Jamie?
- Are there any PTO or schedule constraints in next 2 weeks?

Brief checklist before the 1:1
- [ ] Review INF-342/INF-410 tickets (quick skim)
- [ ] Open PR 1287 diff and note suspicious changes
- [ ] Locate perf dashboard link and latest run results
- [ ] Draft quick note to infra capacity channel in case we need to escalate

Tone notes: keep supportive, avoid micro-managing; ask open questions to surface obstacles; be concrete with offers of help.

Misc / scratchpad (things Sasha might bring up)
- interest in cross-team workshop on batching heuristics
- suggestion to expand evictions telemetry in runtime
- request for a small headcount reprioritization to cover QA spikes

End of prep.
